exactSchedule: Every room, object, route and camera ID is generated exactly once.

site: No target touches the protected late-night water point or its support halo.
No target enters the protected deep dungeon block-entity cells.
Natural terrain is retained through stepped courts, bridges, planted slopes and screened service edges.

evidence: All 18 cameras receive matched first-pass and second-pass evidence after live deployment.
